title: Saltus Framework model configuration
description: Configuration for a Saltus Framework model (custom post type or taxonomy), as loaded from src/models/*.{php,json} by Saltus\WP\Framework\Modeler. Generated by bin/generate-model-schema.php — do not edit by hand.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor autocomplete in JSON models. The framework ignores unknown top-level keys, and a string value keeps Modeler::is_multiple() returning false, so it is safe as the first key.

type.description: Model kind. Required: ModelFactory::create() silently returns null without it.

name.description: Registration slug. Post types are capped at 20 characters and taxonomies at 32; BaseModel::get_registration_name() truncates past that, so the cap is enforced per type by the linter.

active.description: BROKEN — does not work. BaseModel::is_disabled() reads empty($data['active']) || $data['active'] === true, so `false` ENABLES the model and only a truthy non-true value disables it. Gate the model in PHP instead (see src/models/_demo-toggle.php).

block_editor.description: Only `false` has an effect: it disables Gutenberg for this post type.

associations.description: Taxonomy models only: the post types this taxonomy attaches to. A bare string is accepted for a single post type — Taxonomy::set_associations() assigns a non-array value straight through, and register_taxonomy() takes array|string.

options.description: Raw register_post_type() / register_taxonomy() args, plus the two Saltus gates.

show_in_rest.description: Gates the Saltus REST routes. Defaults to ENABLED when absent.

mcp_tools.description: Gates the WordPress-native MCP abilities. Defaults to DISABLED when absent.

features.description: Per-model feature services. A falsy value disables the feature (ModelFactory skips it). Generated from Core::get_service_classes().

ai_assistant.description: The "ai_assistant" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

ai_context.description: The "ai_context" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

blocks.description: The "blocks" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

editorial_review.description: The "editorial_review" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

frontend.description: The "frontend" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

mcp.description: The "mcp" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

meta.description: The "meta" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

quick_edit.description: Keyed by meta key. Each entry needs a title and the admin column it edits.

settings.description: The "settings" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

wp_cli.description: The "wp_cli" feature service. A falsy value disables it.

meta.description: Codestar metaboxes, keyed by an arbitrary identifier.

settings.description: Settings pages, keyed by option name. The key becomes the wp_options row.

ai_context.description: Governance metadata surfaced to AI clients via GET /context/{post_type}.

field_rules.description: Per-field guidance, keyed by field name. Each value MUST be a list of strings: AiContextProvider::field_rules() keeps only string members (array_filter($rules, 'is_string')) and drops any non-array value entirely, so an object of structured constraints is silently mangled rather than rejected.

require_human_review.description: Currently UNREACHABLE per model: ProposalService::should_queue() applies its filter with only the tool name, so no callback can resolve the model. Every mutating tool queues regardless.

oneOf.description: Several models in one file. Every element must be a model object; mixing a single model with siblings silently drops the siblings (Modeler::is_multiple()).

translatableString.description: Human-readable text. In PHP models this should be wrapped in __() with the model text domain.

fieldType.description: A Codestar field type. Constrained to the 44 types the framework ships; anything else is silently ignored at render time.

dependency.description: Conditional display: [ field, operator, value ] with an optional 4th (global) and 5th ("visible") element. Pipe-delimited field/operator/value strings compare several fields at once.

metabox.description: One Codestar metabox. Use either `sections` or a flat `fields` list, not both.

data_type.description: `serialize` stores the whole box in one meta key as a nested object; `unserialize` (the default) writes one key per field.

adminCol.description: An admin list column. Exactly one source key should be set: post_field, meta_key, taxonomy, featured_image, or function.

adminFilter.description: An admin list filter. One of taxonomy, meta_key, meta_search_key, meta_exists, or post_date.

templates.description: Plugin-relative template paths. Absent keys fall back to the framework defaults.
